# EVR Productions

> EVR Productions is a Hyderabad-based photography and film production team serving weddings, family celebrations, events, and brands in Hyderabad and across India.

EVR Productions was founded by photographer Venkat Reddy Eltem. The team creates wedding photography and films, pre-wedding stories, family and event coverage, brand films, marketing reels, and YouTube or podcast productions. Project scope, dates, deliverables, and pricing are discussed directly and confirmed per project.

## Main website

- [EVR Productions](https://www.evrproductions.in/): Official website and current public business information.
- [About EVR Productions](https://www.evrproductions.in/#/about): Founder and company background.
- [Weddings and celebrations](https://www.evrproductions.in/#/weddings): Wedding, pre-wedding, family, and event photography and film services.
- [Selected wedding stories](https://www.evrproductions.in/#/work): Wedding and celebration portfolio.
- [Brand production](https://www.evrproductions.in/#/corporate): Brand films, marketing reels, YouTube, and podcast production.
- [Production services](https://www.evrproductions.in/#/services): Brand production services.
- [Contact EVR Productions](https://www.evrproductions.in/#/request): Start a project enquiry.
